purpose: Restrict a statement to one item in formal language.
keywords: The entrance is on the east side only.
Applications are accepted only by email.
For now, all we can do is wait for recovery.
restrictions: Often equivalent to だけ; can follow particles such as で.
mistake: It is more formal than ordinary spoken だけ.

segments.role: Restrict a statement to one item in formal language. N / plain clause + のみ
